sn56.58:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahāsamudde udakam parikkhayam pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya ṭhapetvā dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni || || 3.
sn56.58:1.3: katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yaṃ vā mahāsamudde udakam parikkhīṇam pariyādinnam yāni vā dve vā tīṇi va udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhānī ti || ||
sn56.58:1.4: Etad eva bhante bahutaram mahāsamudde udakaṃ yad idam parikkhīṇam pariyadinnaṃ || appamattakāni dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhāni
sn56.58:1.5: saṅkham pi na upenti upanidham pi na upenti kalabhāgaṃ pi na upenti mahāsamudde udakam parikkhīṇam pariyādinnam upanidhāya dve vā tīni vā udakaphusitāni avasitthānī ti || || 4--5.
sn56.58:1.6: Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa || so yeva
